about: Synthetic: at a field 1000 ft up (45N 10E), an arrival (id 1: 3 degrees down at 140 kt, pressure altitude 400 ft high, silent for the last 20 s, down at 120 s, ground flag 12 s late) and then a departure (id 2: rolls from 150 s, lifts off 60 s later, 400 ft high too) in one Motion; reports every 5 s, 3 s late.
